title: EPILOGUE // A SOVEREIGN NORTH
narrative: Winterfell's gates are shattered and restored. The direwolf banner flies from every battlement from the Neck to the Wall. With the South in ashes, the North proclaims sovereign independence, closing Moat Cailin forever to the squabbling lords of the Iron Throne.
